achievements.name: Skilled Challenger
achievements.description: Survive through wave 10 in any Endless mode Daily or Weekly Challenge.

achievements.name: Proven Challenger

achievements.name: Veteran Challenger

achievements.name: Welcome To My Backyard
achievements.description: On Heroic difficulty, defeat the Inferno Hydra behind the fire source.

achievements.name: Back And Forth And Back And Forth
achievements.description: On Heroic difficulty, make the Steelrail Overlord cross between carts 9 times.

achievements.name: Pattern Obsession
achievements.description: On Heroic difficulty, in the battle against the Skeleton King, place all blocks only on tiles of the same color and complete the trial.

achievements.name: All Your Base Belong To Me
achievements.description: On Heroic difficulty, defeat the Grand Artificer without activating any Weather Simulators and without letting any Ancient Towers activate.

achievements.description: Unlock Chunk the Builder.

achievements.description: Unlock Tiny the Bot.

achievements.name: Chrono Traveler

achievements.name: Astromancer

achievements.name: No Need For This
achievements.description: Clear the Misty Forest on Heroic difficulty without using any talents.

achievements.name: Save It For The Sequel
achievements.description: Clear the Bone Desert on Heroic difficulty without using any talents.

achievements.name: Skill Issue
achievements.description: Clear the Frost Ruins on Heroic difficulty without using any talents.

achievements.name: Naturally Talented
achievements.description: Clear the Sealed Citadel on Heroic difficulty without using any talents.

achievements.name: Pumpkin Defender
achievements.description: In the Misty Graveyard, survive through wave 20.

achievements.name: That's Not How You Play This Game...
achievements.description: On Normal difficulty or higher, clear a stage without building any blocks.

achievements.name: Seriously, That's Not How You Play This Game...
achievements.description: On Normal difficulty or higher, clear a stage without building any towers.

achievements.name: ...What Tower?
achievements.description: On Normal difficulty or higher, without using an event character, win a run without spending any gold on building towers.

achievements.name: Elementalist
achievements.description: Complete a game on Normal difficulty or higher with only one element of towers (Fire, Ice, Electric, Poison, or Arcane) on the field for the entire run, and clear the boss level.

achievements.name: I'll Take Them All!
achievements.description: Buy out every item in the shop in a single visit.

achievements.name: First Step
achievements.description: Learn your first talent.

achievements.name: Fully Experienced
achievements.description: Learn every talent in the talent tree.

achievements.name: Soul Harvester
achievements.description: Grow the Soul Flame to level 30.

achievements.name: This Isn't Even My Final Form!
achievements.description: Build a tower that covers 5 or more tiles, with every tile being a buff tile.

achievements.name: Flawless Victory
achievements.description: Win a run without taking any damage.

achievements.name: Basic Circuitry
achievements.description: Clear a stage while activating more than three Ancient Devices at the same time.

achievements.name: Advanced Circuitry
achievements.description: In the boss stage of the Sealed Citadel, link all Ancient Devices on the map before the end of round 1.

achievements.name: S.C.R.A.B. Master
achievements.description: Pilot an S.C.R.A.B. that has reached level 35.

achievements.name: Solo Leveling
achievements.description: As the Scrap Master, win a run on Normal difficulty or higher while building towers only on an S.C.R.A.B.

achievements.name: Block Harvester
achievements.description: As the Joker, win a run on Normal difficulty or higher without spending any gold to build towers.

achievements.name: The Floor Is Lava
achievements.description: Have more than 150 tiles of lava on the field at the same time.

achievements.name: All You Can Eat
achievements.description: Fully upgrade a Scrap Tank while holding all "Scrap Master" relics.

achievements.name: Just Want To Watch The World Burn
achievements.description: Have three Flamethrower Towers with a range of over 17 on the field at the same time.

achievements.name: Swift Victory
achievements.description: On Heroic difficulty, defeat a boss with at least half the rounds remaining.

achievements.name: The Chosen One
achievements.description: Obtain the ultimate Giant Dice Tower.

achievements.name: It's Super Effective!
achievements.description: With a single shot from a Lightning Ball Tower, trigger 15 other Lightning Ball Towers to fire.

achievements.name: Mining Time
achievements.description: Collect a total of 2,000 gold from enemies turned into gold.

achievements.name: Car Wash Tactics
achievements.description: Build over 15 Poison Towers consecutively on a straight monster path.

achievements.name: Tower Apprentice
achievements.description: Build 10 different types of towers.

achievements.name: Tower Specialist
achievements.description: Build 30 different types of towers.

achievements.name: Tower Master
achievements.description: Build 45 different types of towers.

achievements.name: Relic Novice
achievements.description: Use more than 20 different Relics.

achievements.name: Relic Explorer
achievements.description: Use more than 40 different Relics.

achievements.name: Relic Collector
achievements.description: Use more than 60 different Relics.

achievements.name: Companion Block
achievements.description: On Normal difficulty or higher, clear any stage with only 1x1 blocks in your backpack.

achievements.name: Professional Mercenary
achievements.description: Successfully complete over 50 quests.

achievements.name: Gambler
achievements.description: Use Gambler's Tokens to reroll more than 150 times.

achievements.name: Purifier
achievements.description: Clear 100 Corrupted or Anomaly stages.

achievements.name: Lengthen The Corridor!
achievements.description: Build a maze that makes monsters walk over 250 tiles before reaching the Fire Source.

achievements.name: Labyrinth Designer
achievements.description: Build a maze that makes monsters walk over 500 tiles before reaching the Fire Source.

achievements.name: World Wonder
achievements.description: Build a maze that makes monsters walk over 1,000 tiles before reaching the Fire Source.

achievements.name: Block Mesa
achievements.description: Make a 13x13 platform with your block cards, then clear the stage.

achievements.name: Through The Darkness
achievements.description: Clear 30 Darkness stages.

achievements.name: Rolling In The Deep
achievements.description: Have the Rolling Log Trap crush more than 50 enemies at once.

achievements.name: Ancient Blessing
achievements.description: Using the Ancient Flame, clear Chaos Realm on Normal difficulty or higher without breaking any tower seals early.

achievements.name: Spawn Camping
achievements.description: On Normal difficulty or higher, kill a large monster within 3 seconds of its appearance.

achievements.name: The Perfect Toolbox
achievements.description: Clear any boss stage with eight towers in your loadout, each of a unique shape.

achievements.name: Chivalry
achievements.description: As Belloc the Pyroguard, complete at least seven quests in a single run and clear the boss stage.

achievements.name: Monopoly
achievements.description: As Silas the Merchant, carry 150 gold into the next stage.

achievements.name: Wait, That's Illegal
achievements.description: As Tana the Sorcerer, have at least five towers on the field simultaneously with the Overcharge buff.

achievements.name: XXXXL
achievements.description: As Chunk the Builder, clear any boss stage while every block in your backpack has a Mega Rune.

achievements.name: System Optimization
achievements.description: As Tiny the Bot, build an elemental 3×3 tower, with all buff tiles beneath it providing that same element bonus.

achievements.name: Final Exam
achievements.description: As Estelle the Astromancer, clear a stage while having at least 25 different types of towers on the field.
